Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
Claiming the Body
Type: Action Modifier
Requires: same circle Sanguinus
Cost: 1 blood
Requires a ready untapped Blood Brother of the same circle as another one who has just been blocked.
[san] Cancel the combat and end the action. (Do not untap the blocking minion.)
[SAN] As above, and untap the acting Blood Brother.

Does the acting or the ready untapped Blood Brother of the same circle as another one, who has just been blocked, pay the blood cost of this card?

Messages.Author: Boris The Blade
Messages.Body:
> XZealot wrote:
> Requires a ready untapped Blood Brother of the same circle as another one who has just been blocked.
>
Requires... always refers to the minion playing the card, so in that case it is the non-acting minion who plays it, with all that entails.

Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
I understood it to be played by the acting minion, as almost all action modifiers are.

It requires that you have an untapped blood brother of the same circle, but not that it is usable or playable by the non-acting vampire.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> XZealot wrote:
> I understood it to be played by the acting minion, as almost all action modifiers are.
>
"Requires a ready untapped Blood Brother of the same circle as another one who has just been blocked."

"The acting minion" and "a ready untapped Blood Brother of the same circle as another one who has just been blocked" can't be the same minion, since you must be acting in order to be blocked.

The "only acting minions can play action modifiers" rule is the default. But some cards explicitely states that someone else can play the card (eg. Veil the Legion, superior Cloak the Gathering). This is the case here.

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> XZealot wrote:
> It requires that you have an untapped blood brother of the same circle, but not that it is usable or playable by the non-acting vampire.
>
Requirements for minion cards are met by the minion playing the card. 1.6.1.3: "Only a minion who meets the requirements given on a minion card can play it"

When Parity Shift says: "Requires a prince or justicar.", it means the minion playing the card must be a prince or justicar.

When Claiming the Body says: "Requires a ready untapped Blood Brother of the same circle as another one who has just been blocked.", it means the minion playing the card must be a ready untapped Blood Brother of the same circle as another one who has just been blocked. The Golden Rule of Cards then allows that Blood Brother to play it even though they are not the acting minion, because it contravenes the normal rules on playing action modifiers.

Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body: I think that makes it better, actually

Messages.Author: Boris The Blade
Messages.Body: There is another template, "Only usable by...", that could make the card clearer.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Non-existant user wrote:
> There is another template, "Only usable by...", that could make the card clearer.
>
Which is the  current revised cardtext :

Only usable by a ready untapped Blood Brother of the same circle as another one who has just been blocked.
[san] End the action (combat does not occur; do not untap the blocking minion).
[SAN] As above, and untap the acting Blood Brother.
